The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a surplus for 2016 (2015: surplus) as detailed below:

2015 comparatives for this disclosure note have been restated. Previously stated figures included the movement on the entire technical account. This movement has been restated to solely include movement on prior year claims outstanding. This has no impact on prior period results.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reported a gross release on prior year claims of GBP 141.341m for 2016 (a favourable movement), representing approximately a 15.4% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016. The release was driven by favourable claims development across property, marine/aviation/transport, third party liability and reinsurance accepted business (noting a small adverse movement in miscellaneous), as shown in the Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding note.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures were extracted from the printed tables. Balance sheet and movement note figures were presented in GBP '000 and converted to millions. Prior year development used the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (gross Insurance liabilities column) and is reported as a gross release of GBP 141.341m. Some LOB mappings (e.g. 'Marine, aviation and transport' -> Marine/Aviation) are approximate where classes are combined; 'Miscellaneous' was mapped to 'Aggregate'. No explicit causal breakdown beyond the movement table was provided.
